Tell me which option you prefer and provide the information. Once you confirm, I’ll verify and then check your Platinum Rewards Card account for any annual-fee rebate eligibility.

I’ll do the email + date of birth option.

My date of birth is **05/12/1991**.  
I’m not sure which email address you have on file for me though—can I verify using my full name instead?
